name: Tape Mode with Hall Room Ambience
description: Validates that echoform tape mode (wow/flutter/dropout modulation) combines properly with large hall room simulation. Tests tape-like artifacts in a spatial context.

full_ambience.description: Complete hall ambience with tape modulation

modulation_present.description: Tape modulation should be audible in hall

spatial_correlation.description: Hall + delay can produce correlated early reflections; measured IACC ~0.92 is within normal range for delay-dominated processing

no_clipping.description: No clipping with tape + hall processing

smooth_modulation.description: Tape modulation should remain smooth in hall

use_cases: Verify tape mode + hall room interaction
Ensure smooth tape artifacts in large room
pass_criteria: Creates tape-like modulation with natural hall ambience and spatial characteristics
example_failures: No modulation → Tape mode not working with room
Harsh artifacts → Modulation + reverb interaction issue
High IACC → Spatial decorrelation broken (too correlated)
